articles.title: China steps up coordinated, tech-enabled response to Typhoon Dolphin
articles.titleCn: 中国加强协调与技术驱动的应对措施以抵御台风“海豚”
articles.summary: China's meteorological, marine, water resources and agricultural authorities have stepped up coordinated emergency response measures after Typhoon Dolphin entered the country's 48-hour warning zone on Wednesday night.
articles.summaryCn: 中国各部门利用人工智能和数字孪生技术，协调应对台风“海豚”，以减轻其对海洋、农业和人民生命财产的潜在影响。

China's meteorological, marine, water resources and agricultural authorities have stepped up {{0}} emergency response measures after Typhoon Dolphin entered the country's 48-hour warning zone on Wednesday night. Authorities are {{1}} advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twin systems, to conduct early {{2}}, improve {{3}} accuracy and strengthen disaster prevention efforts against the approaching typhoon. According to the National Marine Environmental Forecasting Center (NMEFC), the typhoon is moving {{4}} westward with a wind field {{5}} approximately 500 to 600 kilometers from its center. Its outer rain-bands have already begun affecting the East China Sea, and residents in both coastal and inland regions are advised to closely {{6}} its development.
paragraphs.cn: 一张照片显示，2026年8月5日，在中国东部浙江省温岭市石塘镇若山渔港，超过1000艘渔船有序停泊以躲避台风“海豚”。在台风“海豚”于周三晚进入中国48小时警戒区后，中国气象、海洋、水资源和农业部门已加强协调应急响应措施。当局正在利用包括人工智能（AI）和数字孪生系统在内的先进技术，进行早期模拟，提高预报准确性，并加强针对即将来临台风的防灾工作。据国家海洋环境预报中心（NMEFC）称，台风正稳定向西移动，其风场范围从中心延伸约500至600公里。其外围雨带已开始影响东海，沿海和内陆地区的居民被建议密切关注其发展。

paragraphs.en:
Forecasts indicate that coastal waters of the East China Sea may experience {{7}} wave heights of 4 to 7 meters around August 9, with individual wave crests expected to be substantially higher. "The typhoon has an {{8}} wind field and is expected to slow down after entering China's coastal waters," said Huang Huanqing, chief forecaster with the NMEFC. "Its impact may not be readily apparent from the shoreline, making the dangerous sea conditions difficult to perceive. The public should avoid approaching the coast to watch waves and should not {{9}} the risks."
The typhoon is also expected to bring {{10}} torrential rainfall after making landfall. Saturated soil in many parts of eastern Zhejiang Province could significantly increase the risks of flash floods, water-logging and geological disasters.
paragraphs.cn: 预报显示，8月9日前后，东海沿海海域可能出现4至7米的显著浪高，个别波峰预计会更高。“台风风场广阔，预计进入中国沿海海域后会减速，”NMEFC首席预报员黄焕清说。“其影响可能从海岸线不易察觉，使得危险海况难以感知。公众应避免靠近海岸观浪，不应低估风险。”台风登陆后还可能带来长时间的暴雨。浙江东部许多地区土壤饱和，可能显著增加山洪、内涝和地质灾害的风险。

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Water Resources is using digital twin technology and AI-powered flood modeling to simulate flood evolution and develop targeted {{12}} plans in advance. Once potential hazards are detected, an intelligent early warning system will automatically notify responsible officials to ensure a timely emergency response. Affected by Typhoon Dolphin, giant waves over 10 meters high surged off the coast of Shitang in Wenling, east China's Zhejiang Province, August 5, 2026. According to Wang Lin, chief hydrological forecaster with the ministry, provinces including Zhejiang, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Anhui, Jiangsu, Henan and Shandong are expected to experience heavy to torrential rainfall, with isolated areas likely to see extremely heavy downpours. "The public is advised to reduce unnecessary travel and pay close attention to flood forecasts and flash flood warnings issued by water authorities," Wang said.
paragraphs.cn: 水利部正在使用数字孪生技术和人工智能驱动的洪水模型，模拟洪水演变并提前制定针对性应急预案。一旦发现潜在危险，智能预警系统将自动通知负责官员，确保及时应急响应。受台风“海豚”影响，2026年8月5日，中国东部浙江省温岭石塘海岸出现超过10米的巨浪。据该部首席水文预报员王林称，浙江、福建、江西、湖南、湖北、安徽、江苏、河南和山东等省份预计将出现大到暴雨，部分地区可能出现特大暴雨。“建议公众减少不必要出行，密切关注水利部门发布的洪水预报和山洪预警，”王林说。

paragraphs.en: The typhoon is also expected to pose significant challenges to agricultural production. Along China's coast, aquaculture facilities, including offshore fish cages, face the threat of strong waves. In eastern China, late-season rice, fruits and vegetables are {{13}} to lodging caused by strong winds and farmland inundation. Should the typhoon track further north, major autumn grain-producing regions in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain and northeastern China could also be affected by heavy rainfall. The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs has urged farmers to clear drainage channels, improve field drainage, harvest mature crops as early as possible, and {{14}} greenhouses, orchards and other agricultural facilities against strong winds.
paragraphs.cn: 台风预计还将对农业生产构成重大挑战。在中国沿海，包括近海网箱在内的水产养殖设施面临强浪威胁。在华东地区，晚稻、水果和蔬菜易受强风倒伏和农田淹水影响。如果台风路径进一步北移，黄淮海平原和东北地区的主要秋粮产区也可能受到强降雨影响。农业农村部已敦促农民清理排水渠道，改善田间排水，尽早收获成熟作物，并加固温室、果园和其他农业设施以抵御强风。

paragraphs.en: Livestock producers have also been advised to strengthen animal shelters, improve drainage systems and prepare for post-disaster disease prevention and control. Meanwhile, fishing vessels operating in affected waters have been instructed to return to port as soon as possible, while fishermen are urged to {{15}} ashore to ensure their safety. Authorities said every effort will be made to minimize losses and safeguard lives and property as Typhoon Dolphin approaches.
paragraphs.cn: 畜牧生产者也被建议加强动物棚舍，改善排水系统，并做好灾后疾病防控准备。同时，受影响水域作业的渔船已被指示尽快返港，渔民被敦促上岸以确保安全。当局表示，随着台风“海豚”逼近，将尽一切努力减少损失，保护生命和财产。

articles.fullText:
A photo shows more than 1,000 fishing boats moored in an orderly manner to shelter from Typhoon Dolphin, Ruoshan Fishing Port, Shitang Town, Wenling City, Zhejiang Province, east China, August 5, 2026. 
China's meteorological, marine, water resources and agricultural authorities have stepped up coordinated emergency response measures after Typhoon Dolphin entered the country's 48-hour warning zone on Wednesday night.
Authorities are leveraging advanced technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI) and digital twin systems, to conduct early simulations, improve forecasting accuracy and strengthen disaster prevention efforts against the approaching typhoon.
According to the National Marine Environmental Forecasting Center (NMEFC), the typhoon is moving steadily westward with a wind field extending approximately 500 to 600 kilometers from its center. Its outer rain-bands have already begun affecting the East China Sea, and residents in both coastal and inland regions are advised to closely monitor its development.
Forecasts indicate that coastal waters of the East China Sea may experience significant wave heights of 4 to 7 meters around August 9, with individual wave crests expected to be substantially higher.
"The typhoon has an extensive wind field and is expected to slow down after entering China's coastal waters," said Huang Huanqing, chief forecaster with the NMEFC. "Its impact may not be readily apparent from the shoreline, making the dangerous sea conditions difficult to perceive. The public should avoid approaching the coast to watch waves and should not underestimate the risks."
The typhoon is also expected to bring prolonged torrential rainfall after making landfall. Saturated soil in many parts of eastern Zhejiang Province could significantly increase the risks of flash floods, water-logging and geological disasters.
The Ministry of Water Resources is using digital twin technology and AI-powered flood modeling to simulate flood evolution and develop targeted contingency plans in advance. Once potential hazards are detected, an intelligent early warning system will automatically notify responsible officials to ensure a timely emergency response.
Affected by Typhoon Dolphin, giant waves over 10 meters high surged off the coast of Shitang in Wenling, east China's Zhejiang Province, August 5, 2026. 
According to Wang Lin, chief hydrological forecaster with the ministry, provinces including Zhejiang, Fujian, Jiangxi, Hunan, Hubei, Anhui, Jiangsu, Henan and Shandong are expected to experience heavy to torrential rainfall, with isolated areas likely to see extremely heavy downpours.
"The public is advised to reduce unnecessary travel and pay close attention to flood forecasts and flash flood warnings issued by water authorities," Wang said.
The typhoon is also expected to pose significant challenges to agricultural production. Along China's coast, aquaculture facilities, including offshore fish cages, face the threat of strong waves. In eastern China, late-season rice, fruits and vegetables are vulnerable to lodging caused by strong winds and farmland inundation. Should the typhoon track further north, major autumn grain-producing regions in the Huang-Huai-Hai Plain and northeastern China could also be affected by heavy rainfall.
The Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs has urged farmers to clear drainage channels, improve field drainage, harvest mature crops as early as possible, and reinforce greenhouses, orchards and other agricultural facilities against strong winds. Livestock producers have also been advised to strengthen animal shelters, improve drainage systems and prepare for post-disaster disease prevention and control.
Meanwhile, fishing vessels operating in affected waters have been instructed to return to port as soon as possible, while fishermen are urged to evacuate ashore to ensure their safety.
Authorities said every effort will be made to minimize losses and safeguard lives and property as Typhoon Dolphin approaches.

articles.title: No sweat: Robots expected to smash records at Beijing's humanoid games
articles.titleCn: 毫不费力：机器人预计将在北京人形机器人运动会上打破纪录
articles.summary: No sweat: Robots expected to smash records at Beijing's humanoid games
articles.summaryCn: 第二届世界人形机器人运动会将于8月22日在北京开幕，规模扩大、规则更严，机器人将挑战多项世界纪录。

paragraphs.en:
These athletes don't sweat, don't complain, and they're about to {{0}} world records. "Let the games begin" will ring out across Beijing's "Ice Ribbon" on August 22 for the second World Humanoid Robot Games. Co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal Government and China Media Group, the event has {{1}} from three days to five, with sessions now running in the afternoon and evening. By the numbers: A leap forward
This year's games feature 51 events and 1,301 matches across five days — nearly double the 26 events and 487 matches of the {{2}} edition. A total of 666 teams and 2,056 robots from 16 countries across six continents are {{3}}, a 138% increase in teams and a fourfold increase in robots.
paragraphs.cn: 这些运动员不流汗、不抱怨，而且即将打破世界纪录。8月22日，“让比赛开始”的口号将在北京“冰丝带”响起，第二届世界人形机器人运动会将在此举行。本届赛事由北京市政府和中国中央广播电视总台联合主办，会期从三天延长至五天，比赛时间安排在下午和晚上。数字一览：飞跃式进步 今年的运动会设有51个比赛项目和1301场比赛，为期五天——几乎是首届26个项目和487场比赛的两倍。共有来自六大洲16个国家的666支队伍和2056台机器人参赛，队伍数量增长138%，机器人数量增长四倍。

paragraphs.en:
The United States, Germany, Japan, and other robotics {{4}} are fielding teams, while Brazil has {{5}} a squad of five Robot World Cup champions. Domestically, 157 enterprises, 641 teams, and 1,975 robots are taking part, with all major industry players present. Teams from 27 Chinese universities are competing, {{6}} 30 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, and special administrative regions. What's new: From show to real-world readiness
The {{7}} games now feature 30 competitive events and 21 scenario-based events — up from just six scenario events last year. Scenario events {{8}} nine real-world environments: households, hotels, industrial settings, emergency rescue, logistics, libraries, retail, office services, and vehicle charging.
paragraphs.cn: 美国、德国、日本等机器人强国均派出队伍参赛，巴西则组建了一支由五名机器人世界杯冠军组成的队伍。国内方面，157家企业、641支队伍和1975台机器人参赛，所有主要行业参与者悉数到场。来自27所中国大学的队伍参赛，覆盖30个省、自治区、直辖市和特别行政区。新变化：从展示到实战准备 改版后的运动会设有30个竞技项目和21个场景项目——而去年仅有6个场景项目。场景项目模拟九种真实环境：家庭、酒店、工业场所、紧急救援、物流、图书馆、零售、办公服务和车辆充电。

paragraphs.en:
Two new challenges are pushing the {{9}} of what robots can do in practical settings:
The Dexterous Hand Challenge test {{10}} across tool assembly, powder weighing, block stacking, nail driving, bottle opening, unboxing, tweezer pick-up, and cable connection. Micro-distance vision, motion planning, force control precision, and {{11}} accuracy all come into play. The "Integrated Five" Challenge requires robots to perform dexterous operations, stable object transfer, and heavy lifting while running a 100-meter dash. Rules getting tougher
To raise the bar, time limits have been cut sharply: the 100-meter race from three minutes to one; the 400-meter from 15 minutes to five; and the 1,500-meter from 40 minutes to 15. Autonomy requirements are stricter too: all track events and competitive events must be fully autonomous — no remote control — except for the 100-meter and 400-meter obstacle races.
paragraphs.cn: 两项新挑战正在推动机器人在实际应用中的能力边界：灵巧手挑战测试工具组装、粉末称重、积木堆叠、钉钉子、开瓶、开箱、镊子拾取和电缆连接等精密操作。微距视觉、运动规划、力控精度和操作准确性都至关重要。“五项全能”挑战要求机器人在进行100米短跑的同时完成灵巧操作、稳定物体转移和重物搬运。规则更加严格 为提高标准，时间限制大幅缩短：100米赛跑从三分钟缩短至一分钟；400米从15分钟缩短至五分钟；1500米从40分钟缩短至15分钟。自主性要求也更加严格：所有田径项目和竞技项目必须完全自主——不允许遥控——除了100米和400米障碍赛。

paragraphs.en:
In scenario events, fully autonomous completion earns a weight {{13}} of 1.0, while remote-controlled completion is capped at 0.5. One notable rule change: in robot soccer, goals only count if at least two teammates have touched the ball during the build-up — a {{14}} move to discourage one-robot solo performances and encourage team {{15}}. The rule tests communication and collaboration, not just individual hardware {{16}}. What to watch
Gold medals are up for grabs across all nine sessions, with 12 decided on on August 23, second only to the closing day. The opening ceremony evening features a 7v7 soccer exhibition match plus 400-meter and 100-meter {{17}}.
paragraphs.cn: 在场景项目中，完全自主完成获得1.0的权重系数，而遥控完成的上限为0.5。一项值得注意的规则变化是：在机器人足球比赛中，只有在进攻过程中至少有两名队友触球，进球才算有效——这是为了故意阻止单机器人单打独斗，鼓励团队协作。该规则考验的是沟通和协作能力，而不仅仅是个人硬件实力。看点 九个场次均有金牌争夺，其中8月23日将决出12枚金牌，仅次于闭幕日。开幕式当晚将举行7对7足球表演赛以及400米和100米预赛。

paragraphs.en: Freestyle combat finals and a 5v5 soccer final come before the closing. Track records are expected to {{18}}. In April a humanoid robot finished a half-marathon in 50 minutes and 26 seconds, faster than the human world record. Robot soccer players have also improved, now able to {{19}}, power-shot, and dive to save. Freestyle combat runs across eight sessions in three weight classes: 40kg, 58kg, and 80kg — all significantly more competitive than last year.
paragraphs.cn: 自由搏击决赛和5对5足球决赛将在闭幕式前举行。田径纪录预计将被打破。今年4月，一台人形机器人以50分26秒完成半程马拉松，比人类世界纪录还快。机器人足球运动员也有所进步，现在能够运球、大力射门和扑救。自由搏击比赛共八个场次，分为三个重量级别：40公斤、58公斤和80公斤——所有级别都比去年更具竞争力。

paragraphs.en: A newly added {{20}} event will award lightweight and heavyweight golds on August 24. Dance events have grown from 29 teams to 108, with robots competing in street dance, ballroom, and {{21}}. This year's event features 223 {{22}} — 100 more than last year — including 28 international-level, 75 national-level, and 120 first-tier officials. An {{23}} committee has been strengthened to handle disputes promptly.
paragraphs.cn: 新增的举重项目将于8月24日颁发轻量级和重量级金牌。舞蹈项目从29支队伍增加到108支，机器人将参加街舞、国标舞和啦啦操比赛。今年的赛事共有223名裁判——比去年多100名——其中包括28名国际级、75名国家级和120名一级裁判。仲裁委员会也已加强，以便及时处理争议。

articles.fullText:
These athletes don't sweat, don't complain, and they're about to smash world records. "Let the games begin" will ring out across Beijing's "Ice Ribbon" on August 22 for the second World Humanoid Robot Games.
Co-hosted by the Beijing Municipal Government and China Media Group, the event has expanded from three days to five, with sessions now running in the afternoon and evening.
By the numbers: A leap forward
This year's games feature 51 events and 1,301 matches across five days — nearly double the 26 events and 487 matches of the inaugural edition.
A total of 666 teams and 2,056 robots from 16 countries across six continents are competing, a 138% increase in teams and a fourfold increase in robots.
The United States, Germany, Japan, and other robotics powerhouses are fielding teams, while Brazil has assembled a squad of five Robot World Cup champions.
Domestically, 157 enterprises, 641 teams, and 1,975 robots are taking part, with all major industry players present.
Teams from 27 Chinese universities are competing, spanning 30 provinces, autonomous regions, municipalities, and special administrative regions.
What's new: From show to real-world readiness
The revamped games now feature 30 competitive events and 21 scenario-based events — up from just six scenario events last year.
Scenario events simulate nine real-world environments: households, hotels, industrial settings, emergency rescue, logistics, libraries, retail, office services, and vehicle charging.
Two new challenges are pushing the boundaries of what robots can do in practical settings:
The Dexterous Hand Challenge test precision across tool assembly, powder weighing, block stacking, nail driving, bottle opening, unboxing, tweezer pick-up, and cable connection. Micro-distance vision, motion planning, force control precision, and operational accuracy all come into play.
The "Integrated Five" Challenge requires robots to perform dexterous operations, stable object transfer, and heavy lifting while running a 100-meter dash.
Rules getting tougher
To raise the bar, time limits have been cut sharply: the 100-meter race from three minutes to one; the 400-meter from 15 minutes to five; and the 1,500-meter from 40 minutes to 15.
Autonomy requirements are stricter too: all track events and competitive events must be fully autonomous — no remote control — except for the 100-meter and 400-meter obstacle races.
In scenario events, fully autonomous completion earns a weight coefficient of 1.0, while remote-controlled completion is capped at 0.5.
One notable rule change: in robot soccer, goals only count if at least two teammates have touched the ball during the build-up — a deliberate move to discourage one-robot solo performances and encourage team coordination.
The rule tests communication and collaboration, not just individual hardware prowess.
What to watch
Gold medals are up for grabs across all nine sessions, with 12 decided on on August 23, second only to the closing day.
The opening ceremony evening features a 7v7 soccer exhibition match plus 400-meter and 100-meter preliminaries.
Freestyle combat finals and a 5v5 soccer final come before the closing.
Track records are expected to tumble. In April a humanoid robot finished a half-marathon in 50 minutes and 26 seconds, faster than the human world record.
Robot soccer players have also improved, now able to dribble, power-shot, and dive to save.
Freestyle combat runs across eight sessions in three weight classes: 40kg, 58kg, and 80kg — all significantly more competitive than last year. A newly added weightlifting event will award lightweight and heavyweight golds on August 24.
Dance events have grown from 29 teams to 108, with robots competing in street dance, ballroom, and cheerleading.
This year's event features 223 referees — 100 more than last year — including 28 international-level, 75 national-level, and 120 first-tier officials. An arbitration committee has been strengthened to handle disputes promptly.

这些运动员不流汗、不抱怨，而且即将打破世界纪录。8月22日，“让比赛开始”的口号将在北京“冰丝带”响起，第二届世界人形机器人运动会将在此举行。本届赛事由北京市政府和中国中央广播电视总台联合主办，会期从三天延长至五天，比赛时间安排在下午和晚上。数字一览：飞跃式进步 今年的运动会设有51个比赛项目和1301场比赛，为期五天——几乎是首届26个项目和487场比赛的两倍。共有来自六大洲16个国家的666支队伍和2056台机器人参赛，队伍数量增长138%，机器人数量增长四倍。

美国、德国、日本等机器人强国均派出队伍参赛，巴西则组建了一支由五名机器人世界杯冠军组成的队伍。国内方面，157家企业、641支队伍和1975台机器人参赛，所有主要行业参与者悉数到场。来自27所中国大学的队伍参赛，覆盖30个省、自治区、直辖市和特别行政区。新变化：从展示到实战准备 改版后的运动会设有30个竞技项目和21个场景项目——而去年仅有6个场景项目。场景项目模拟九种真实环境：家庭、酒店、工业场所、紧急救援、物流、图书馆、零售、办公服务和车辆充电。

两项新挑战正在推动机器人在实际应用中的能力边界：灵巧手挑战测试工具组装、粉末称重、积木堆叠、钉钉子、开瓶、开箱、镊子拾取和电缆连接等精密操作。微距视觉、运动规划、力控精度和操作准确性都至关重要。“五项全能”挑战要求机器人在进行100米短跑的同时完成灵巧操作、稳定物体转移和重物搬运。规则更加严格 为提高标准，时间限制大幅缩短：100米赛跑从三分钟缩短至一分钟；400米从15分钟缩短至五分钟；1500米从40分钟缩短至15分钟。自主性要求也更加严格：所有田径项目和竞技项目必须完全自主——不允许遥控——除了100米和400米障碍赛。

新增的举重项目将于8月24日颁发轻量级和重量级金牌。舞蹈项目从29支队伍增加到108支，机器人将参加街舞、国标舞和啦啦操比赛。今年的赛事共有223名裁判——比去年多100名——其中包括28名国际级、75名国家级和120名一级裁判。仲裁委员会也已加强，以便及时处理争议。

articles.fullText:
a is bracing for the possible impacts of a powerful El Nino event that could develop through 2026 and continue into 2027, raising concerns over extreme weather, food security and livelihoods across the continent.
El Nino occurs when sea surface temperatures in the central and eastern tropical Pacific Ocean become unusually warm. The warming can alter atmospheric circulation and disrupt weather patterns thousands of kilometres away.
"There have been observations by the US meteorological agencies around the Pacific Ocean. Whenever the ocean warms up, there is a lot of rearrangement in terms of the climate and how it affects us here in East Africa. What has been observed currently is that there is a four-to-five chance that it's going to be a super El Nino," according to Dr James Mumina, a research scientist at the University of Sussex.
What could it mean for Africa?
The effects of El Nino vary across the continent, depending on the region, season and interaction with other climate systems.
CGTN visited the IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Centre, where weather experts are crunching decades of weather-related data, which is particularly significant for countries including Kenya, Somalia, Uganda, Tanzania, Ethiopia and South Sudan, where millions of people depend on seasonal rains for farming and livestock.
"For the upcoming October to December season, which is an important rainfall season particularly for Kenya, Somalia, southern Ethiopia, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi and Tanzania, El Nino is likely to result in above-normal rainfall," Hussein Said, a meteorologist at the IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center said.
The region is already experiencing significant climate variability, with some areas facing drought while others contend with flooding and intense rainfall.
"For the October to December season, the signals are even stronger. El Nino will have a stronger impact during the October to December season compared to the current season. We have an over 80% chance that the season is going to be above normal," Said added.
Turning forecasts into action
According to climate experts, the key concern is not only how strong the El Nino becomes, but whether governments and communities can act early enough to reduce its impact.
Vehicles navigate through flooded streets as heavy rains cause severe flooding in Nairobi, Kenya, May 1, 2026. /CFP
Seasonal forecasts can help authorities pre-position emergency supplies, strengthen flood preparedness, advise farmers on planting decisions, protect water resources and prepare health facilities for potential emergencies.
"The first gap is the last mile between a forecast and a decision. In OND 2023, and again during the devastating long rains of March to May 2024 in Kenya, which killed around 300 people and affected 42 of our 47 counties, the forecasts were broadly right. What lagged was converting them into evacuations, pre-positioned supplies and pre-emptive water management," Dr. Mumina said.
For communities, timely and accessible information can help people make decisions before extreme weather strikes.
"What IGAD is doing is trying to transition the region from more response-oriented, reactive approaches to proactive approaches. IGAD has developed a regional roadmap on anticipatory action, which means that based on a forecast, you start acting. You don't wait for the drought or floods to impact communities or their assets," said Dr. Ahmed Amdihun, Head of Disaster Risk Management at IGAD.
As scientists continue to monitor the evolving El Nino conditions, governments across Africa are being urged to strengthen preparedness and ensure climate warnings reach communities in time.
The African Union has called for collective preparedness through stronger early warning systems, advising that climate inaction could cost some African economies over 5% of their GDP.

该案例凸显了数字技术在入侵物种控制中的作用。监督模型整合了监测数据、公众投诉和互联网信息，将不同时期的植被影像与入侵物种名单进行比较，以识别潜在位置。卫星遥感、无人机和地理信息系统（GIS）空间分析有助于确定入侵物种的分布和覆盖范围，包括难以进入的区域。人工智能辅助识别结合专家评估，也可以支持物种识别和证据收集。

paragraphs.en:
The yellow salsify is seen in Beijing, China. /China Media Group
Similar digital approaches are being used elsewhere. Procuratorial authorities in Jilin Province have established a big-data early-warning platform for ragweed control, while Chongqing Municipality and Hunan and Jiangxi provinces have {{20}} big-data legal supervision models. The Ecological and Environmental Code will take effect on August 15. Experts said it will strengthen requirements for environmental supervision through information, digital and {{21}} technologies, establish mechanisms for environmental information sharing, and strengthen {{22}} among government departments.
paragraphs.cn:
黄鸦葱在北京出现。/中央广播电视总台
类似的数字方法正在其他地方使用。吉林省检察机关已建立了豚草控制的大数据预警平台，而重庆市和湖南、江西省已部署了大数据法律监督模型。《生态环境法典》将于8月15日生效。专家表示，该法典将通过信息化、数字化和智能化技术加强对环境监管的要求，建立环境信息共享机制，并加强政府部门之间的协调。

paragraphs.en: The code is expected to provide stronger legal support for a full-chain approach to invasive species control, covering monitoring and early warning, treatment, verification, and coordinated prevention and control.

articles.fullText:
A plant that looks like a giant dandelion is drawing attention in Beijing's Tongzhou District. Yellow salsify (Tragopogon dubius) grows tall and upright and develops a fluffy, fist-sized seed head after flowering.
The district has cleared more than 57,000 of the plants at 148 sites, covering more than 68,000 square meters, using digital technologies to improve invasive species monitoring and ecological restoration.
The Tongzhou District People's Procuratorate identified multiple sites through a public-interest litigation supervision model, satellite remote sensing and expert assessment.
The plant was included in Tongzhou's survey list of invasive species in forests, grasslands and wetlands in 2023. Experts said it has strong adaptability and rapid reproduction, and may, if it becomes widespread, compete with native plants for water, soil nutrients and living space.
Satellite remote sensing was used to estimate its distribution. Authorities then worked with experts to develop a treatment plan combining manual removal, deep burial and replacement with native vegetation.
A follow-up assessment found that the methods had not caused secondary damage to native soil or vegetation. In some areas, native plants were replanted to increase vegetation coverage and help prevent recurrence.
Uprooted yellow salsify plants. /China Media Group
The case highlights the role of digital technologies in invasive species control. The supervision model integrates monitoring data, public complaints and internet information, comparing vegetation imagery from different periods with invasive species lists to identify potential locations.
Satellite remote sensing, drones and geographic information system (GIS) spatial analysis can help determine the distribution and coverage of invasive species, including in areas difficult to access. AI-assisted identification combined with expert assessment can also support species identification and evidence collection.
The yellow salsify is seen in Beijing, China. /China Media Group
Similar digital approaches are being used elsewhere. Procuratorial authorities in Jilin Province have established a big-data early-warning platform for ragweed control, while Chongqing Municipality and Hunan and Jiangxi provinces have deployed big-data legal supervision models.
The Ecological and Environmental Code will take effect on August 15. Experts said it will strengthen requirements for environmental supervision through information, digital and intelligent technologies, establish mechanisms for environmental information sharing, and strengthen coordination among government departments.
The code is expected to provide stronger legal support for a full-chain approach to invasive species control, covering monitoring and early warning, treatment, verification, and coordinated prevention and control.

articles.title: Why does 'eat well' mean so much in China?
articles.titleCn: 为什么“吃好”在中国意义如此重大？
articles.summary: Wherever there are people, you'll find a Chinese restaurant – or so the joke goes.
articles.summaryCn: 文章通过电影和日常场景，阐述“吃好”在中国文化中不仅是关于食物，更象征着家庭团聚、情感修复和生活价值观的传承。

paragraphs.en: How do you get to know China from abroad? For many, it begins somewhere {{0}}: a Chinese restaurant on a street corner. There's an old joke that wherever people go, a Chinese restaurant follows. It's an {{1}}, of course, but quite a {{2}} one, as it speaks to a culture that has spent centuries perfecting the art of the meal, and to something quieter still: the way a {{3}} table, set anywhere in the world, can carry the full weight of someone's hope for a {{4}} life. People walk past a poster of the film "Once Upon a Time in the Middle East" in Wuhan, Hubei Province on August 11, 2026.

paragraphs.en: The film Once Upon a Time in the Middle East opens on exactly this kind of table. A Chinese chef has traveled abroad to cook at a local restaurant – nothing more {{5}} than paying off debt, sending money home. Then the war finds him. He is no hero, just a man trying to survive. But {{6}}, it turns out, is not the same as {{7}}, and he ends up {{8}} a group of local children from a conflict that was never his to begin with.
paragraphs.cn: 电影《中东往事》正是从这样一张桌子开始。一位中国厨师出国到当地一家餐馆做饭——他的目标不过是还清债务、寄钱回家。然后战争找到了他。他不是英雄，只是一个试图生存的人。但事实证明，生存不等于冷漠，他最终保护了一群当地儿童免受一场本不属于他的冲突的伤害。

paragraphs.en: A family enjoys their Spring Festival reunion dinner at home in Lanzhou, Gansu Province on January 28, 2025. Through it all, one phrase returns again and again: Eat well. A wedding feast is held in Congjiang County of Guizhou Province on February 5, 2026. It sounds almost too simple to mean anything. But in Chinese, it rarely just means food.

Residents affected by an earthquake in Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture, Gansu Province are provided with hot food on December 21, 2023. That's what a shared table does in Chinese life.
paragraphs.cn: 它的意思是：保持完整。与重要的人保持亲近。让这顿饭成为说出难言之隐、获得原谅或干脆搁置问题的地方。2023年12月21日，甘肃临夏回族自治州地震受灾居民获得热食。这就是共享餐桌在中国生活中的意义。

Weddings, funerals, homecomings, goodbyes – almost nothing of {{11}} happens in a Chinese life without a meal built around it. Elderly residents enjoy free lunch at an elder care service facility in Nantong, Jiangsu Province on August 13, 2026. "There's nothing a meal can't fix," goes a saying popular online – half joke, half genuine philosophy.

Residents enjoy a community Spring Festival gathering in Nanchong, Sichuan Province on February 10, 2026. So, when someone tells you to eat well, take it seriously. It's never just about food. articles.fullText:
How do you get to know China from abroad? For many, it begins somewhere unglamorous: a Chinese restaurant on a street corner. There's an old joke that wherever people go, a Chinese restaurant follows. It's an exaggeration, of course, but quite a telling one, as it speaks to a culture that has spent centuries perfecting the art of the meal, and to something quieter still: the way a modest table, set anywhere in the world, can carry the full weight of someone's hope for a decent life.
People walk past a poster of the film "Once Upon a Time in the Middle East" in Wuhan, Hubei Province on August 11, 2026. 
The film Once Upon a Time in the Middle East opens on exactly this kind of table. A Chinese chef has traveled abroad to cook at a local restaurant – nothing more ambitious than paying off debt, sending money home. Then the war finds him. He is no hero, just a man trying to survive. But survival, it turns out, is not the same as indifference, and he ends up shielding a group of local children from a conflict that was never his to begin with.
A family enjoys their Spring Festival reunion dinner at home in Lanzhou, Gansu Province on January 28, 2025. 
Through it all, one phrase returns again and again: Eat well.
A wedding feast is held in Congjiang County of Guizhou Province on February 5, 2026. 
It sounds almost too simple to mean anything. But in Chinese, it rarely just means food. It means: stay whole. Stay close to the people who matter. Let this meal be where the hard things get said, or forgiven, or simply set aside.
Residents affected by an earthquake in Linxia Hui Autonomous Prefecture, Gansu Province are provided with hot food on December 21, 2023. 
That's what a shared table does in Chinese life. It's where families actually spend their time together. It's how old friendships get renewed and grudges quietly dissolve. Weddings, funerals, homecomings, goodbyes – almost nothing of consequence happens in a Chinese life without a meal built around it.
Elderly residents enjoy free lunch at an elder care service facility in Nantong, Jiangsu Province on August 13, 2026. 
"There's nothing a meal can't fix," goes a saying popular online – half joke, half genuine philosophy. Because embedded in the ritual of eating together are the values that hold a family and a community together: gentleness, humility, restraint, respect, the long patient work of getting along.
Residents enjoy a community Spring Festival gathering in Nanchong, Sichuan Province on February 10, 2026. 
So, when someone tells you to eat well, take it seriously. It's never just about food. It's an instruction for how to live – and who to love.
Giant panda Gong Gong enjoys a specially-prepared "birthday cake" at Hainan Tropical Wildlife Park and Botanical Garden in Haikou, Hainan Province on August 17, 2025.
articles.fullTextCn:
如何从国外了解中国？对许多人来说，这始于一个不起眼的地方：街角的中餐馆。有一个老笑话：无论人们走到哪里，中餐馆都会随之而来。这当然是一种夸张，但相当有说服力，因为它体现了一种花了几百年完善饮食艺术的文化，以及一种更安静的东西：一张朴素的桌子，无论摆在世界何处，都能承载一个人对体面生活的全部希望。2026年8月11日，人们走过湖北武汉一张电影《中东往事》的海报。

电影《中东往事》正是从这样一张桌子开始。一位中国厨师出国到当地一家餐馆做饭——他的目标不过是还清债务、寄钱回家。然后战争找到了他。他不是英雄，只是一个试图生存的人。但事实证明，生存不等于冷漠，他最终保护了一群当地儿童免受一场本不属于他的冲突的伤害。

2025年1月28日，甘肃兰州，一家人在家享用春节团圆饭。在这一切中，有一句话反复出现：吃好。2026年2月5日，贵州从江县举行婚宴。这句话听起来太简单，似乎没什么意义。但在中文里，它很少仅仅指食物。

它的意思是：保持完整。与重要的人保持亲近。让这顿饭成为说出难言之隐、获得原谅或干脆搁置问题的地方。2023年12月21日，甘肃临夏回族自治州地震受灾居民获得热食。这就是共享餐桌在中国生活中的意义。

这是家人真正共度时光的地方。这是老朋友重归于好、怨恨悄然化解的方式。婚礼、葬礼、归乡、告别——在中国生活中，几乎没有什么重要的事情不围绕一顿饭展开。2026年8月13日，江苏南通，老年人在养老服务机构享用免费午餐。网上流行一句话：“没有什么是一顿饭解决不了的”——半是玩笑，半是真正的哲学。

因为共餐仪式中蕴含着维系家庭和社区团结的价值观：温柔、谦逊、克制、尊重，以及长期耐心相处的努力。2026年2月10日，四川南充，居民参加社区春节聚会。所以，当有人告诉你“吃好”时，请认真对待。它从来不只是关于食物。它是关于如何生活的指导——以及爱谁。

2025年8月17日，海南海口，海南热带野生动植物园里，大熊猫“贡贡”享用特制的“生日蛋糕”。
